jobs.title: People Partner Lead, Germany & Sweden
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Why this role exists

You’ll help build Neko’s clinical organisation in Germany from the ground up, and then lead the people strategy that helps it scale.

Neko’s clinics are where our mission comes to life. The experience members have is shaped by the teams behind it, making the organisation itself one of the most important products we build. In Germany, this organisation doesn’t exist yet. Before the first clinic opens, you’ll help define clinical roles, workforce planning, compensation, and the employee experience that attracts exceptional talent. Then, as clinics launch and grow, you’ll partner with leaders to ensure those teams perform, develop, and scale successfully.

This is a rare opportunity to build an organisation from day one – and to shape what it becomes as Neko brings prevention-first healthcare to another market.

Phase one: build the foundation, pre-launch

  • Ensure the German employment framework is appropriately set up with legal, external counsel, key internal teams, like People Ops and Workforce Planning – contracts, working-time and rostering models, pay structures, policies, payroll and people systems

  • Design the clinic organisation from a blank sheet, and a staffing model sized to Neko’s ambition for the market rather than to the first clinic

  • Own the launch workforce plan, the cover and contracting model, and reward in a German context – pay, pension, equity

  • Build a German clinical employer proposition from zero with TA, and a playbook the next market can reuse

Build for German employment structures from day one

  • Design workforce policies (scheduling, pay, performance) with German labor law and employee representation requirements in mind from the start

  • Work with legal counsel to determine the right structure for German clinic operations

  • Ensure people systems and tools are built to comply with German labor regulations

Phase two: run clinical people strategy live

  • Be the day-to-day People partner across German clinical leadership, from senior operations and medical leaders through to frontline clinic managers

  • Spend real time in clinics, and read what members experience there as signal about how teams are resourced, structured and led – spotting strain, inconsistency or risk early, because it usually shows up in the clinic room before it shows up in the data

  • Coach clinic leaders through hiring, performance and the conversations that are hard but important – and build the leadership capability and multi-way feedback culture that keep employee relations issues from piling up, while supporting teams and leaders through the ones that do

  • Support first-time clinic managers as they build confidence, capability and steady leadership habits

  • Hold the staffing model against the growth plan: German absence, leave and part-time realities, the clinical qualification and mobility pipeline, and honesty when the plan and the labour market disagree

  • Turn central People programmes into clinic-ready practice, and call out where a centralised approach misses frontline reality

  • Revisit what you built pre-launch as clinics run, and put data and AI to work in how the People agenda actually operates – sharper decisions, less manual effort, more time on the judgement calls

  • Take change from decision to genuine adoption, bringing clinic teams with you without pausing delivery to do it

Beyond Germany

  • Help drive the global People Partner team’s clinical strategy rather than just feed into it

  • Bring the German clinical reality into that team's agenda, so decisions made at scale hold up on the ground

  • Support the wider European market as it grows, and other markets as needed

What you bring

  • 8+ years as a senior People or HR Business Partner leader, across senior levels of leadership and frontline leaders of larger teams

  • A builder's mindset – comfortable starting from a blank sheet, having opened or scaled operations in Germany or built a German people function from close to nothing

  • Deep, practical command of German employment law and co-determination, with the judgement to know when to bring in counsel

  • Germany is the core requirement; multi-market European experience is strongly preferred – you have worked across more than one European employment landscape (Sweden a significant plus) and know what scales beyond a single market

  • Has built a staffing model that had to scale on an opening cadence, and has localised reward in Germany – pay, pension, equity

  • Comfortable in both phases – the ambiguity of pre-launch and the discipline of running something live

  • Moves at the pace of the business and leads people through change – you have taken teams through reorganisations, new operating models or rapid scaling, and kept trust and delivery intact while doing it

  • A local delivery mandate and a real seat in cross-market strategy, held at the same time, at pace

  • Fluent with people data and using AI in your own work, and ties people decisions to what members actually experience in the room

  • Fluent German and English, based in Berlin, and ready to spend regular time in clinics

jobs.description:
DEINE ROLLE

Du bist auf Instagram, LinkedIn & Co. zu Hause, hast ein gutes Gespür für Content und kannst selbst starke Posts, Reels und Stories produzieren? Du interessierst dich außerdem für Wirtschaft, Investments und die Welt rund um Vermögen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Social Media Manager (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, unsere Social-Media-Kanäle weiterzuentwickeln – von der ersten Content-Idee über die Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Content-, Brand- und Podcast-Team zusammen und bringst deine eigenen Ideen und dein Gespür für guten Social Content ein.

Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate. Ob Social Posts, Reels, Podcast-Clips oder Event-Content: Du hilfst uns dabei, komplexe Finanz- und Investmentthemen verständlich, relevant und visuell stark für Social Media aufzubereiten.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Social Media & Planung: Du betreust unsere Kanäle auf Instagram, LinkedIn und Facebook und planst gemeinsam mit dem Team, welche Themen und Formate wann und wo stattfinden.

  • Content Creation: Du entwickelst Posts, Carousels, Reels und Stories von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Gleichzeitig machst du aus bestehenden Inhalten wie Magazinartikeln, Marktkommentaren, Interviews, Events oder Expertengesprächen eigenständigen Social Content – von starken Hooks und Captions bis zu Recaps und Key Takeaways.

  • Podcast & Video: Du unterstützt bei der Produktion von That’s Smart Money und entwickelst aus unseren Gesprächen relevante Clips und Short-Form-Content. Dabei arbeitest du unter anderem mit Riverside und unseren Video-Tools.

  • Trends & neue Ideen: Du beobachtest, welche Formate und Mechaniken auf Social Media funktionieren, und überlegst, was davon zu LIQID passt. Gute Ideen sollst du bei uns nicht nur vorschlagen, sondern auch ausprobieren können.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Du verstehst Social Media und hast bereits selbst Content gemacht: Ob für einen eigenen Account, ein Projekt, dein Studium oder ein Unternehmen, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, dass du ein gutes Gespür dafür hast, was auf Social Media funktioniert.

  • Du kannst Geschichten erzählen und richtig gut schreiben: Du erkennst den interessanten Gedanken in einem Thema, findest einen starken Einstieg und kannst auch komplexere Inhalte verständlich und präzise auf den Punkt bringen.

  • Du hast ein gutes visuelles Gespür und Lust auf Produktion: Fotografie, Typografie, Layout und Video interessieren dich und du setzt Content gerne selbst um. Erfahrung mit Riverside, CapCut, Premiere oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du packst selbst an: Du arbeitest eigenständig und zuverlässig, bringst Ideen mit und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate zu übernehmen.

  • Du bist neugierig auf Finanzthemen: Du musst noch kein Investment-Profi sein. Aber Wirtschaft, Märkte und Investments interessieren dich und du hast Lust, dich auch in komplexere Themen einzuarbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team: Du hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Content, Brand, Podcast und anderen Bereichen aus einer guten Idee richtig guten Content zu machen.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte – und geben dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, LIQID und das Team kennenzulernen.

  • Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit unserer Social Media Managerin Verena: Wir tauschen uns darüber aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Kleine praktische Aufgabe: Du bekommst eine Aufgabe, die sich an typischen Themen aus deinem zukünftigen Arbeitsalltag orientiert. So sehen wir, wie du Content denkst und umsetzt – und du bekommst einen konkreten Eindruck von der Rolle.

  • Gespräch mit unserer Hiring Managerin Lenika & Team: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle ein, sprechen über deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und geben dir einen Einblick in unsere Content- und Social-Media-Arbeit.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. jobs.title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 20.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

Als (Senior) Customer Success Manager (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die ganzheitliche Betreuung deines Kundenportfolios – vom erfolgreichen Onboarding über nachhaltige Produktnutzung bis hin zu Retention, Vertragsverlängerungen und Wachstum. Dabei agierst du als Trusted Advisor für deine Kund:innen und sorgst mit datenbasierten Entscheidungen und kommerziellem Verständnis dafür, dass sie langfristig erfolgreich sind und gemeinsam mit plancraft wachsen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du betreust ein eigenes Kundenportfolio über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle – von Onboarding und Onboarding und Adoption bis hin zu Retention und Expansion.

  • Du führst Onboardingtermine durch und unterstützt Kund:innen dabei, schnell messbaren Mehrwert mit plancraft zu erzielen.

  • Du analysierst Nutzungsdaten, Health Scores und Portfolio-KPIs, um Chancen und Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu priorisieren.

  • Du erstellst strukturierte Customer Success Pläne und führst Business Reviews mit deinen Kund:innen durch.

  • Du erkennst Churn-Risiken frühzeitig und leitest gezielte Maßnahmen zur Kundenbindung ein.

  • Du identifizierst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale, qualifizierst diese und schließt Erweiterungen eigenständig ab.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Support, Product, Revenue Operations, Sales und Marketing zusammen, um die bestmögliche Customer Experience zu schaffen.

  • Du bringst strukturiertes Kundenfeedback in Product- und Go-to-Market-Teams ein.

  • Du entwickelst Playbooks, Dokumentationen und skalierbare Customer-Success-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv den Aufbau einer proaktiven und datengetriebenen Customer-Success-Organisation mit.

DEIN PROFIL

Must-haves

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten B2B-SaaS-Rolle.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung eines Kundenportfolios über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle.

  • Ausgeprägte Beratungsfähigkeit kombiniert mit Sicherheit in kommerziellen Kundengesprächen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen sowie datenbasiertem Portfolio-Management, Dashboards und Health Scores.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigenverantwortung und ausgeprägte Priorisierungsfähigkeit.

  • Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills.

  • Du verfolgst einen value-driven Verkaufsansatz und verbindest nachweisbaren Kundenmehrwert mit relevanten Expansion-Potenzialen.

  • Freude daran, in einem dynamischen Umfeld mitzuwirken und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit Consultative Selling, Expansion Playbooks oder kommerziellen Verhandlungen.

  • Erfahrung im SMB- oder Mid-Market-SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Kenntnisse in HubSpot, Intercom, Looker oder Customer-Health-Plattformen.

  • Erfahrung im Handwerk, Bauwesen oder verwandten Branchen.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Customer-Success-Prozesse.

  • Interesse an AI-gestützten Workflows und Automatisierung.

  • Weitere europäische Sprachkenntnisse.

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

  • Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.

  • AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen Claude-Lizenz, selbstverständlich.

  • Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst.

  • Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten.

  • Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen.

  • Internationales Umfeld: Wir werden stetig internationaler mit Kolleginnen u. a. in Italien, Frankreich, den Niederlanden und Österreich – und kommunizieren intern auf Englisch.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. jobs.title: Senior Game Designer - Systems & Economy - Fully Remote
jobs.description:
At SOFTGAMES, we build games played by millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Game Designer (Systems & Economy) to help evolve our leading games. You will own the long-term evolution of one or two existing games with a loyal player base, balancing player satisfaction, engagement, and commercial performance.

In this role, you will own the design and optimization of progression, economy, events, and monetization systems. Your mission is to continuously evolve these games by creating compelling short-, mid-, and long-term goals that keep players engaged for months and years while maximizing player satisfaction and business performance.

*Qualified applicants will be expected to complete a design test.

This is a remote position.

Your Role:

  • Design, balance, and optimize the game’s economy, progression, and reward systems.

  • Create engaging player motivation loops across events, features, and monetization.

  • Develop and maintain a cohesive ecosystem of LiveOps events, ensuring they work together rather than compete for player attention.

  • Design systems that improve retention, engagement, and monetization while preserving a great player experience.

  • Build and maintain economy models, balancing spreadsheets, and simulations.

  • Use data to identify player friction points, progression bottlenecks, and monetization opportunities.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, BI, UA, Art, and Development teams to improve game performance.

  • Analyze KPIs such as Retention, ARPDAU, Conversion, LTV, and Engagement to guide design decisions.

  • Drive feature and event improvements through continuous testing, iteration, and experimentation.

  • Clearly communicate design rationale, trade-offs, and recommendations across the team.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years of experience designing and operating successful F2P mobile games.

  • Strong experience in systems design, economy design, progression design, and LiveOps.

  • Proven track record working on casual or puzzle games.

  • Deep understanding of player motivation, retention mechanics, and monetization design.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to design and evaluate A/B tests and translate data into actionable improvements.

  • Comfortable making decisions based on KPIs and player behavior.

  • Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to identify opportunities without waiting for direction.

  • Ability to quickly understand new games, systems, and player audiences and take ownership when moving between projects.

  • Advanced spreadsheet skills and experience building balancing, simulation, and forecasting models.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.

  • Passion for creating engaging and sustainable player experiences.

  • Proficient in using AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, and decision making.

Benefits:

SOFTGAMES offers a competitive package, including:

  • Remote-first, your way — Work fully remote from wherever you do your best work, or drop into our modern Berlin office whenever you like. You choose

  • Flexible hours — Structure your working hours to your needs. No crunch culture. No overtime

  • Generous vacation — Time to recharge, wherever in the world you are

  • Home office budget — We fund your setup so your home office actually works for you

  • Learning & development — Training budget for everyone, whether you're deepening expertise or picking up something entirely new

  • Top-tier equipment — A high-spec laptop, ready to get your best work done

  • Meal allowance — A monthly budget dedicated to your lunches

  • Home office utility grant — We cover a monthly contribution toward your electricity and internet costs

  • Company swag — Hoodies, bags, mugs — the good stuff

  • Annual company retreat — At least once a year, the whole company comes together to connect, align, and celebrate. Our events in general are epic but our off-site Retreat is one of a kind.

At SOFTGAMES, we value a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone's ideas are heard and valued. Join our dynamic team and be part of the exciting world of mobile gaming. Apply now and let your expertise shine!


SOFTGAMES is the leading instant gaming company. We develop casual, truly social games that can be played instantly across all devices. Our hypersocial blockbuster game “Bubble Shooter Pro” became a global top grossing game on Facebook and is played by millions of people around the world every day. We partner closely with Facebook, Samsung and more to craft the next generation of instant games that billions of people can play together. SOFTGAMES is a remote first company and the home of 100 people from all over the world. We believe in proactive, independent teams with the freedom to take initiative, challenge the status quo, and with the mission to create fun and everlasting Instant Games.

At SOFTGAMES, we believe that different perspectives and background in our teams contribute to the quality of our work. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion / worldview, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity.

Have we caught your interest? Then we look forward to your detailed application.

jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 

Ready to awaken your best with us? 

 

About The Role

 

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to drive online revenue growth for Emma's EU Ecommerce team. You will be responsible for owning paid channels campaigns end to end, so that every euro invested delivers a measurable return.

You'll work closely with key stakeholders, ranging from Global Performance Marketing and Creative Marketing to Brand Marketing and the different EU Ecommerce country teams.


What You'll Do
  • Own paid campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Affiliates, Influencer, CRM and TV (linear and CTV), from strategy through execution to continuous optimization.
  • Run A/B tests across creatives, audiences and landing pages, and turn the results into repeatable playbooks that raise performance across your channels and your market.
  • Stay ahead of platform changes, algorithm updates and market trends, and proactively bring new tools, tactics and opportunities to the team.
  • Define and drive performance targets such as ROAS, CPA and conversion rate, and turn data from attribution tools and in-house dashboards into clear strategic decisions.
  • Own your revenue target and deliver local, regional or global projects on time, becoming the go-to expert for the channels you own.
  • Collaborate with global performance and creative teams on ad messaging, budget allocation and channel mix to maximize return on every euro invested.
  • Partner with Sales to drive commercial performance across products and categories in your market, aligning campaign plans with commercial priorities.

Who We're Looking For
  • You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Finance, Business Administration or Engineering, which gives you a solid base for data-driven decisions.
  • You have 3+ years of relevant in-house experience in B2C Ecommerce, ideally in FMCG, consumer goods or online services, with ownership of paid performance channels.
  • You bring strong analytical skills and a strategic understanding of paid channels, turning performance data into decisions that grow revenue and improve ROAS.
  • You have project management experience, having delivered local, regional or global projects on time while aligning multiple stakeholders along the way.
  • You are proactive and self-reflective: you bring ideas instead of waiting for tasks, take feedback well and own your channels with autonomy.
  • You collaborate well and communicate in a structured way, building a strong network across teams, agencies and partners to deliver shared results.
  • You are fluent in English and German.

What We Offer
  • The opportunity to create real impact, take ownership and accountability, and drive meaningful change.
  • Continuous learning and development through hands-on experience, mentoring, formal training, and access to tools such as our Learning Hub and Nilo.
  • A collaborative community of smart, driven people where you learn, contribute, and connect, every day and through team events.
  • A global environment, working daily with diverse perspectives across 4 offices and 70+ nationalities.
  • 25 vacation days per year, with 1 extra day per year worked (until a limit of 30 days per year).
  • A flexible hybrid setup with up to 22 remote days per quarter, and offices in Gutleutviertel - Frankfurt.
Become an Emmie

We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 

Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description

Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


Your mission

1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

  • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

  • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

  • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

  • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

  • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

  • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

  • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

  • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

  • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

  • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

  • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

What We Want to Achieve Together

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


Your profile

  • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

  • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

  • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

  • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

  • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

  • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

  • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


Why us?

  • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

  • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

  • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

  • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


Process

  1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

  2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

  3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

  4. Meet the team in the office.

  5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

How to Apply

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.


What you'll do

Architecture

  • Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

  • Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

  • Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

  • Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

  • Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

    • Configuration & tooling

  • Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

  • Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

  • Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure


    • What we're looking for

    Required

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. jobs.description:
Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe can reindustrialize if we bring together AI X energy market opportunities X industrial processes. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) make their energy decisions with our Energy OS. Behind it is RIZMO: our autonomous AI agent acts as a digital colleague that builds independently, analyzes continuously, iterates with energy management and uncovers cost-saving potential.

As a Field Value Engineer, you bring RIZMO directly to our industrial clients – with both feet on-site. You don't roll out a finished product; you actively build the engine: you train the agent with feedback from the field and make savings visible in euros and megawatt hours. Iteration cycles in hours, not quarters.

Tasks

Digital Twin: Build live models of entire energy systems – power, gas, steam, water, waste heat, generation and battery storage – including smart-meter and OPC UA integration.

Decision Hub: Develop scenarios, business cases, what-if analyses and investment roadmaps together with our clients.

Operation Hub: Support cross-site live optimization across day-ahead, intraday and grid services markets.

Autonomous Agent: Make RIZMO better – parsing technical documents, researching parameters, running optimizations, finding cost reductions – and feed every insight from the field straight back into the engine.

Commercial Ownership: Uncover unstated requirements from operators, plant managers and CFOs, defend business cases up to C-level, and measure your success in euros per unit saved.

Requirements

Education & Background: Degree in energy engineering, automation engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable STEM qualification.

Energy Intelligence: You understand DACH/EU electricity markets (day-ahead, intraday, grid services), physics and thermodynamics, and how production processes interact with energy. Experience with OPC UA, Modbus and OT networks is a plus.

AI-Native & Applied AI Engineering: You treat hallucinations as an engineering problem, have strong intuition for optimization and numerical models, and can convince even security officers of an agent's reliability.

Maker Mindset (High Agency & High Ownership): You iterate fast, treat customer feedback as your highest-priority input, and deliver results instead of waiting for instructions.

Language Skills: German at C1 level – most on-site work happens in German. If everything else fits but your German isn't C1 yet: apply anyway.

Benefits

Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education.

Radical Performance Culture: Exceptional results get rewarded directly – with an uncapped OTE bonus of €5k–50k on top of your base salary. Seniority (junior to senior) is decided during the process, not by your title – don't be put off if you see yourself as more senior. Advancement is based on performance, not tenure.

Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent).

Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club.

On-site Culture & Team Spirit: During your first year, you'll work from our office in Münster – that's where you'll get to know our system in depth and join the first deployments hands-on. After that, you'll work close to our clients in one of our industrial clusters (Rhine-Main, Rhine-Ruhr, Bavaria, Benelux).

Not a customer success job, not 9-to-5, not pure algorithm development. Send us the thing you're proudest of – and what you'd most like to build next.

jobs.title: People Partner Lead, Corporate Functions, Product & Tech
jobs.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

About Neko Health

Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Our mission is to redesign healthcare by shifting the focus from reactive treatment to proactive and preventive care.

We are building a new kind of healthcare experience designed to help people stay ahead of their health. By combining medical expertise with breakthrough technology, we make it possible to quickly and non-invasively gather a broad picture of a person's health and deliver clear insights within minutes.

Headquartered in Stockholm and New York, Neko Health offers the Neko Body Scan experience across Europe and the US, supported by a growing team of people working to transform how healthcare is delivered.

Why this role exists

Legal, Finance and People are what let Neko operate, hire and stay compliant as it scales, and Product & Technology is the largest, most complex function at HQ. These aren't the same kind of problem. Each function sits at a different stage of maturity, and this role isn't about pulling them into one shape. It's about moving fluidly between genuinely different disciplines, bringing the right kind of people practice to each, rather than defaulting to a single playbook.

This is one of the most senior People roles at HQ outside the Global People Lead itself. It suits a senior level HR operator who's genuinely comfortable holding several different kinds of problem at once, and who brings real depth in organisational design, workforce planning, strategy and culture, genuine command of each rather than surface-level familiarity.

What you'll do

Own the people agenda across Corporate Functions and partners with the Global People lead on parts of the Product & Tech organisation

  • Lead workforce planning and organisational design across Legal, Finance, People, (and support to parts of the Product & Technology teams) role clarity, resourcing decisions and structural recommendations tailored to each function's stage

  • Meet each function on its own terms, building where a function is still finding its shape, optimising where it's stable, rather than applying one approach everywhere

  • Build genuine partnership with the leaders who run each of these teams, calibrating the relationship to what each one needs

Be the strategic partner to senior leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner across Legal, Finance, People and some of the Product & Technology teams, translating business strategy into people priorities, programmes and operating plans for each function

  • Coach and challenge leaders on the decisions that shape the organisation they'll be running next year, thinking a step ahead of today's priorities

  • Bring sound judgement and discretion to the most sensitive people matters across all four functions

Champion Neko's culture and Vitals

  • Partner with leaders across Legal, Finance, People and parts of the Product & Technology to embed Neko's cultural Vitals into how their teams actually operate, day to day

  • Help leaders translate the Vitals into practical behaviours and decisions across genuinely different functions

  • Build the rituals and feedback loops that keep culture genuinely lived as each function matures at its own pace

Drive talent management across Corporate Functions and Product & Tech

  • Working in partnership with the Growth & Engagement team to drive leadership development, performance and engagement for the leadership population across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology

  • Advise on compensation, mobility and promotions in partnership with Reward & Enablement, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness across genuinely different functions

Lead change and manage risk

  • Lead and sponsor change initiatives that affect structure or operating model in any of these functions, owning scope, timeline, stakeholder engagement and change readiness from start to finish

  • Manage employee relations matters across Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology, working directly with Legal colleagues and specialist counsel to resolve issues with discretion and confidentiality

  • Spot risk early, whether that's capacity strain in Legal or Finance, or Product & Technology's pace outstripping its structure

Drive organisational design and workforce planning

  • Use workforce and org data to shape decisions ahead of need

  • Deliver people analytics and actionable insights that turn data into clear, decision-ready recommendations

  • Put data and AI to work in how the people agenda runs day to day, sharper decisions, less manual effort

Bring the right practice to functions at different stages

  • Recognise that Legal, Finance, People and Product & Technology each need different structures, rhythms and support, and build accordingly

  • Turn central People programmes into practice that fits each function's actual culture and maturity

  • Experience evaluating how AI informs talent decisions and org design, bringing the judgement to design with AI as a genuine participant in how roles and structures should look, actively shaping the work itself.

What you bring

  • Deep, hands-on experience across organisational design, workforce planning, people strategy and culture, genuine depth in all four, built through direct ownership rather than generalist HRBP exposure

  • 10+ years in senior HR Business Partner, People Partner, or People/HR leadership roles, including ownership of the people agenda across genuinely different functions at Director level or above

  • Experience owning leadership development and performance calibration outcomes for a senior leadership population

  • A track record of personally leading change initiatives end to end: scope, timeline, and stakeholder engagement

  • A genuine passion for culture and values, with experience helping leaders embed them into how their teams actually work

  • A track record of partnering with and influencing senior functional leaders on complex, high-stakes organisational decisions, operating with genuine autonomy as an independent decision-maker

  • Comfort holding functions at very different stages of maturity at once, adapting approach rather than applying one framework to all

  • Fluent with people data and actively using AI in your own work

  • Working knowledge of employment law relevant to Neko's HQ locations, with the judgement to know when to bring in specialist expertise

About Titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so internal titles may differ from market-facing role titles. Scope, impact and level of the role are fully aligned and will be clearly discussed throughout the process.

Hiring Process

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews, culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

We are at an inflection point in our journey. Our platform now serves tens of thousands of learners, demand for AI skills is accelerating, and we are investing seriously in the product and technology that will take us to the next stage of scale. This is a role for someone who wants to build the product that gets more people into transformative learning, and upskill people with critical data and AI skills faster.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Prescribe: the product that helps a prospective learner find the right programme for their skills and their employer's goals, then takes them to a confident commitment and a successful start. You will be the strategic counterpart to a Senior Engineering Manager, working alongside design and data, and closely with our go-to-market and fulfilment teams.

Growth at Multiverse means getting more people from first interest to a confident start, and it is a product problem, not a marketing problem. You will own the conversion metrics, set the strategy, run the experiments, and drive the outcomes. AI will drive much of the improvement, and you will decide where it helps.

As a Lead, you will work regularly with the most senior leaders across the company. You will report to the Single Threaded Leader for Diagnose & Prescribe and will not manage other product managers. The role is based in London, hybrid, three days a week in the office.

What You'll Own

AI-native product experiences

  • Shape new conversational, AI-first experiences that help learners and customers understand the best programme for their skills and career development.

  • Decide where AI genuinely improves a match and where it only adds noise, and build the evaluation and guardrails that keep it trustworthy in front of real users.

  • Turn learner and customer behaviour into product direction.

Prescription and eligibility

  • Own the logic that connects a learner's skills to a programme and to a customer's levy funding, where mistakes carry a real financial and regulatory cost.

  • Work with Legal, Compliance and Fulfilment to make eligibility and compliance rules configurable and explainable, so business owners can change them without a rebuild.

  • Make every recommendation something a learner and a customer can understand and challenge.

Recommendation, commitment and finalisation

  • Own the journey from recommendation to a learner committing and starting.

  • Identify high-leverage drop-off points and own the experimentation roadmap.

  • Design product interventions that adapt to learner needs and behaviour and shorten the time to a confident start.

  • Collaborate with GTM, Operations and Data teams to improve attribution and the quality of what enters the funnel.

Metrics and experimentation

  • Own conversion from prospect to committed learner, with retention and programme fit as the guardrails.

  • Champion a culture of hypothesis-led, structured experimentation.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Co-own the strategy and roadmap with your Senior Engineering Manager, with disagreement surfaced early and alignment as your shared deliverable.

  • Involve GTM, Fulfilment and Support before changes ship. They run what we build, so know their biggest pain points.

  • Author the narratives the group needs, from the press release and FAQ (PRFAQ) for your area to the sales-facing briefing for a launch.

  • Represent Prescribe in roadmap conversations with senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

The best candidates will have owned a growth-critical product before, ideally in a B2B or ideally a B2B2C context. You should have hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features and the ability to navigate complexity without losing sight of the learner.

Must-have experience:

  • Substantial experience as a PM with a track record of improving measurable growth metrics (acquisition, activation, retention, automation).

  • Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards.

  • Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments.

  • Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies.

  • Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts.

  • Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content.

  • AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies.

Strong signals we look for:

  • Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context.

  • Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic.

  • Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users.

  • A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise.

  • A bonus if you've done this in a regulated environment, such as funding, eligibility or compliance-heavy products. Knowledge of UK apprenticeships and the levy is an additional plus.

How you work:

  • Solve for Customer Value: You're direct about data, even when it challenges existing priorities.

  • Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good.

  • Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity: You're comfortable with ambiguity and define structure in new spaces.

  • AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work.

Not for you if:

This role won't fit if you'd rather write specs than stay close to the data, the design, and the customer. It also won't fit if you see AI as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a product team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on a product that genuinely changes economic trajectories.

  • A team that takes craft seriously and holds a high bar.

  • Direct access to senior leadership and meaningful influence over product direction.

  • A place in a company rebuilding itself as product-powered and AI-native, where you help define the result rather than inherit it.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

jobs.title: Algorithm Developer (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe's plants run on gas, power, heat and steam – and all of them are being rebuilt at the same time. The hard part isn't ambition, it's arithmetic: which asset to buy, when to run it, what to hedge. Europe's largest companies (~2% of total energy demand) answer these questions with our Energy OS: a digital twin of the site, an optimizer that plans it, and agents that operate it.

The optimizer is yours. Twenty-year investment decisions, quarter-hourly dispatch, real tariffs, real market rules. You report directly to the CTO – and nobody stands between your model and the plant it runs on.

Tasks

Optimization Models End-to-End: Own capacity expansion planning over multi-year horizons, dispatch at quarter-hour resolution, and MIP production scheduling with sequence-dependent setup times.

Model Physics & Contracts: Storage, thermal networks, transmission, flexibility, self-consumption, minimum part loads, start-up costs – formulate what reality actually demands.

Make It Solve: Tighten big-Ms, scale models cleanly, decide where decomposition earns its complexity – and where it doesn't.

Smart Data Reduction: Time series clustering, extreme periods, segmentation and aggregation – without accuracy quietly disappearing.

Regulation into Constraints: Model grid fees, levies, tariffs, balancing power and intraday trading per country, and understand what they do to the objective function.

Prove It's Right: Test cases on real customer systems, fixtures that catch regressions, and infeasibility output an engineer can actually diagnose.

Interface & Production: Define inputs and outputs with the Product Engineers; own the runs on Kubernetes – solve time, memory and cost are your numbers.

Explain to the Customer: When a customer questions a schedule, you're the one who can say why the model chose it.

Requirements

Education & Background: Degree in mathematics, operations research, computer science, physics, energy systems engineering, business mathematics or a comparable STEM qualification.

Optimization: Deep familiarity with LP and MILP and the craft around it – formulation strength, relaxations, warm starts, solver behavior.

Practice over Papers: You've taken a model from formulation to production that others depended on.

Code & Solvers: Strong Julia – or strong Python/C++ and a real appetite to learn Julia (JuMP) fast. Hands-on with Gurobi or HiGHS, including reading logs and knowing when to reformulate instead of tuning.

Data Sense & Engineering: Comfortable with long time series, unit and sign conventions; tests, version control, code review and CI are second nature.

AI-Native: Claude Code, agents and subagents are part of your daily loop – a requirement, not a plus.

High Ownership, Low Ceremony: You take on the unclear. Energy domain knowledge helps but isn't required.

Nice to have: Stochastic or robust optimization, Benders or column generation, unit commitment, energy market modeling.

Benefits

Share in the Success: Competitive base salary plus equity – we set your level during the process, not based on your CV.

Top-Tier Venture Capital Network: Direct access to the Point 9 and Earlybird networks – including formats for sparring, mentoring and further education.

Unforgettable Team Offsites (Workation): Once a year, the whole team goes on a workation. Including exclusive exchanges with our Visionary Voices (e.g. Robert Habeck, Kitty Mayo, James Vincent).

Corporate Health: Full flexibility for your fitness and health with Urban Sports Club.

Out to the Plant: Seeing the boiler you modeled changes how you build the product.

Our stack: Julia with JuMP on Gurobi and HiGHS, forecasting in Python, the product in TypeScript (Vue, Node, PostgreSQL), Google Cloud with Kubernetes for optimization jobs, GitLab CI, agents on LangGraph.

Small team, no layers between you and the decision. A model change that lands on Tuesday is in front of the customer on Thursday. In-person onboarding, then hybrid from Munich, Düsseldorf or Münster.

Not a research position without deployment – and not a place where solve time is someone else's problem.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.title: Process Engineer - Semiconductor Processes
jobs.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Support equipment qualification, troubleshooting and process recovery following equipment interventions. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Characterize the impact of fabrication parameters on material and device performance. 
  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Strong knowledge of dry etching, ideally including hands-on experience with ICP-RIE. 
  • Experience with one or more complementary processes such as RIE, PECVD, physical vapor deposition / metal evaporation and lithography. 
  • Strong understanding of how fabrication parameters can influence material properties and device performance. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with optical and electrical characterization of semiconductor or optoelectronic devices. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 
  • Knowledge of Python or other programming languages for process-data analysis, automated reporting, instrument control or experimental automation. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new processes where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Our mission is to provide cheaper, greener energy to the French market.

 

Octopus Energy France is a fast-growing energy company recognized as an ESS (social economy). **We offer a better experience to our customers through transparency, honesty and simplicity. We want to do better for the planet, through real, long-term investment in renewable energy production and a low-CO2 future that's better for our customers' wallets. We want to revolutionize the energy business through our people, our platform and our use of data.

 

Our focus is on customer satisfaction, and receiving positive reviews is important to us - we have the best score among French energy suppliers on Google Reviews and Trust Pilot.

 

Kraken technologies

 

Kraken Technologies is a company within Octopus Energy Group who are licensing the Kraken platform and operating model to clients across the world. Current clients are both the Octopus Energy retails businesses around the world as well as external clients such as Good Energy, Origin, EDF, E.ON & Queensland Energy - with many more expected to join over the next few years!

 

Our team

 

All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 450 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and designers.

We follow a Kanban-like approach, using Google docs and Asana to specify and manage work; Github, CircleCI and Terraform Enterprise as part of an immutable-infrastructure, continuous delivery pipeline; and Loggly, Sentry and Cloudwatch to measure performance and monitor production.

Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

 

Our technology

 

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and the Django-REST-framework. We also use Pandas, Numpy and Jupyter for analysis and forecasting, plus Celery, RabbitMQ, SQS and Airflow for background processing.

 

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

 

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.
